acceptanceCriteria: The fold is incremental or bounded; a test or measurement at two history sizes shows per-call cost does not grow with history.
Review results are byte-identical to the current fold on existing fixtures.
body:
Location: internal/tasks/cli/external_review.go around lines 86, 117 and 607 (line numbers from the lane branch; re-check on main). Observed: the review-fold state is recomputed from scratch per call, so cost grows with review history. Expected: incremental or bounded fold.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
title: Review-fold state is rebuilt on every call in internal/tasks/cli/external_review.go
